judgment.rationale: Both are BASIC 1 Indicators (rank 0, same canonical Grade coordinate) under STRAND 2: READING but in different sub-strands and under different Content Standards: first is B1.2.2.1.2 'Recognise and produce letter names and sounds randomly' (Sub-Strand 2: Phonics, under B1.2.2.1 'Connect sounds to letters and blend letters/syllables in order to read and write'); second is B1.2.1.2.2 'Orally segment spoken syllables/words into individual sounds e.g. stop = s-t-o-p' (Sub-Strand 1: Pre-Reading Activities, under B1.2.1.2 'Manipulate the sounds of the letters of English'). Source evidence and one LC record for the second SFI are truncated, but the retained statement text and hierarchy are sufficient for this symmetric judgment.
